context: Two friends chat about a date
purpose: Teach: 左利き/つまん/シャイ/へー/かくして/戸惑っ/うっとり/噛む

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日のデート、彼、左利きだったの、気付いた。
lines.en: I noticed something yesterday on our date — he's left-handed.
lines.style: Bright, warm opening. Soft wonder in the voice. Noticing something small and holding it like a small gift. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へー、つまんない時間じゃなかった?
lines.en: Oh really? The time didn't feel dull then?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, leaning in. Light, inviting tone. Checking in with real interest, not just being polite.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。彼、最初、シャイで、寡黙だった。
lines.en: No, not at all. He was pretty shy at first — didn't talk much.
lines.style: Animated, almost buzzing with the memory. Speaking a bit faster, more present. The energy of someone reliving a moment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: へー、徐々に打ち解けたのね。
lines.en: Oh, so he opened up as things went on?
lines.style: Warm and encouraging. Nodding in the voice. Following the thread naturally, inviting her to keep going.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 告白されて、かくして、お付き合い、始まったの。
lines.en: Yeah. He actually told me how he felt, and that's how we started dating.
lines.style: Shy, still processing the realness of it. A little breathless on the key moment. Trailing off softly at the end, like she's half-smiling.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最初は、戸惑ったでしょ、急展開で。
lines.en: You must have been surprised though — that's quite a turn of events.
lines.style: Gently probing, not pushing. Warm curiosity about how she handled it. Reading her to see if she needs to talk more about it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。手を握られて、うっとりしちゃった。
lines.en: I was. When he took my hand, I just… melted.
lines.style: Soft, almost whispered. Vulnerable. The memory makes her voice smaller. A little wonder at herself for feeling it so deeply.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 幸せを噛むように味わってるね、メイちゃん。
lines.en: You're really savoring this happiness, aren't you, Mei? Like you're tasting every bit of it.
lines.style: Warm close observation. Tender. Not teasing — genuinely moved by watching her feel this. Voice steady, intimate, the tone of someone who knows her well.
